entities.summary: Syed Mohammad Ahsan was a Pakistani retired three-star rank naval officer who served as the fourth Commander-in-Chief of the Pakistan Navy from 1966 to 1969, the eighth Finance Minister of Pakistan in 1969, and eleventh Governor of East Pakistan from 1969 until 1971 when he was removed for refusing to support military action there. He later served as the fourth chairman of the Port Qasim Authority from 1978 to 1980.
